projects.title: Awesome-LLM-Long-Context-Modeling
projects.description: A curated repository of long-context language modeling. Browse chapters on the project page; full entries live in the GitHub papers/ directory.

projects.title: Adaptive Resolution for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
projects.description: A lightweight allocator decides how much visual budget each frame gets before encoding, improving the efficiency–accuracy trade-off under aggressive compression with a frozen MLLM.

projects.title: Awakening Augmented Generation
projects.description: Awakens latent knowledge in LLMs with explicit and implicit imagination, without retrieval-heavy pipelines, on open-domain and closed-book QA.

projects.title: Task Adapters Generation from Instructions
projects.description: Generates task-specific adapters from instructions via hypernetworks and distillation, improving cross-task generalization with lower compute than instance-only training.

projects.title: Distill Yourself
projects.description: Indexes AI coding sessions, distills durable preferences and working patterns, and feeds them back into future agent sessions through auditable memory.

projects.title: Dynamic Parametric Retrieval-Augmented Generation
projects.description: Moves part of retrieval augmentation into dynamic parametric memory, so test-time knowledge can grow without only lengthening the context.

projects.title: Modular training for fine-tuning LLMs
projects.description: A user-friendly, highly integrable framework for fine-tuning large language models with less boilerplate than typical training stacks.
